section.title: Removal intent
section.para: The radome hinges or detaches to provide weather-radar maintenance access without degrading RF, sealing, or bonding performance over repeated removal cycles.

proceduralStep.para: Confirm effectivity: eWTW baseline, MSN-001..050, status active.
Place the aircraft in a safe maintenance state and protect the weather-radar installation envelope aft of the radome.
Identify and tag any referenced LPS or WXR hardware attached at the interface; do not claim or remove system-owned content under this module unless released by the owning branch instructions.
Release the radome hinge/latch or detach hardware at the radome backup bulkhead interface while preserving owned seals, drainage features, and bonding provisions for reuse/inspection.
Support and remove the radome assembly without inducing damage to the fairing, outer/inner skins, dielectric core, erosion boot/coating, or interface provisions.
